'''Explorer maps''' are filled maps that mark the location of a structure. In Matcha Flavoured they are sold by the [[Archaeologist]] and the [[Wandering Trader]] for a single [[Obol]] each (the Overgrown Abbey map costs a copy of [[Paradise Lost]] or [[The Divine Comedy]] instead), with no compass needed. The pack adds maps to many more structures than vanilla ''Minecraft'', including its own [[Overgrown Abbey]] and [[Papal Outpost]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Archaeologist ===
The [[Archaeologist]] (the renamed cartographer) sells 13 maps across its five levels. Each map trade can be used 999 times.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/1/mineshaft.json}}</ref>

The Papal Outpost map searches for pillager outposts, because the papal outpost generates in their place.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/worldgen/structure/on_papal_outpost_explorer_maps.json}}</ref> The Overgrown Abbey map is the only one bought with a book instead of an obol; there are two separate trades, one for each book.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/3/abbey_paradise_lost.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/3/abbey_divine_comedy.json}}</ref> The Papal Outpost and Overgrown Abbey maps have their own item textures.

=== Abandoned camps ===
{{Upcoming|the 26.3 port}}
Abandoned camps come from ''Minecraft'' 26.3, so they are not in 1.12.4, which is for 26.2. In the 1.12.3 alpha for 26.3 and on the repository's 26.3 branch, the chests of an [[abandoned camp]] hold maps too. A common chest has a map to a camp in a different biome: the Bamboo Camp Map, Birch Forest Camp Map, Cherry Grove Camp Map, Dappled Forest Camp Map, Flower Forest Camp Map, Pale Garden Camp Map, Swamp Camp Map and Windswept Forest Camp Map. A camp never holds the map that leads to its own biome's camp.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/abandoned_camp_common_chest.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref> A secret chest has one map to a buried structure: Buried Ancient City Map, Buried Trial Chambers Map, Buried Mineshaft Map, Desert Pyramid Map, Jungle Pyramid Map, Warm Ocean Ruins Map or Woodland Mansion Map.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/abandoned_camp_secret_chest.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref> The secret chest's maps are named items of ''Minecraft'' 26.3 itself.

=== Other maps ===
Buried treasure maps are found in shipwreck map chests, as in vanilla ''Minecraft''; see [[Buried treasure]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/shipwreck_map.json}}</ref> [[Ocean ruins]] chests also hold buried treasure maps; the pack's tables give them no destination of their own, so they use the game's default, buried treasure.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/underwater_ruin_small.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/underwater_ruin_big.json}}</ref> In the 1.12.3 alpha for 26.3 these maps had a woodland mansion as their destination, so they led to the nearest [[Woodland Mansion|mansion]]; the 26.3 branch has fixed this.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/underwater_ruin_small.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
When the villager reaches the level that offers a map, the game searches for the nearest structure of that type within 100 chunks. If one is found, the map is drawn with the structure's marker; if not, that trade is left out of the villager's offers.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/4/ancient_city.json}}</ref> Every copy bought from the same villager leads to the same structure.

Compared with vanilla, where a cartographer's explorer maps cost 8 to 14 emeralds plus a compass and can be bought a few times before restocking, every other Matcha Flavoured map costs a single obol, and the Overgrown Abbey map costs a copy of [[Paradise Lost]] or [[The Divine Comedy]].

== Trivia ==
* The Desert Temple Map uses the desert village marker, and the Trail Ruins Map uses the plains village marker.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/2/trail_ruin.json}}</ref>
* The language file also contains the name "Archive Map", for the planned [[Archive]], but no trade or loot table gives one.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref>
* The developer has described a plan in which sacred texts are traded for maps that lead from one structure to the next, with the Archaeologist buying sacred texts; the Overgrown Abbey map is the first trade of this kind.<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref>
* The developer's to-do list includes making map trades require a secondary item, such as an empty map.<ref>{{Source|changelog.md}}</ref>
